nodes.description: owner: contract owner address stored in owned, set from msg.sender and changed by transferOwnership
name: token display name, writable by changeName under onlyOwner
symbol: token ticker, writable by ChangeSymbol under onlyOwner
decimals: fixed at 18, used in the constructor supply scaling exponent
totalSupply: total token supply, decreased by burn and burnFrom
balanceOf: mapping of address to token balance, mutated by _transfer, burn and burnFrom
allowance: nested mapping of owner to spender approvals, written by approve and decremented by transferFrom/burnFrom
msg.sender: caller controlled address used as owner, balance index, allowance key and callback recipient
owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: overwrites owner
TokenERC20 constructor(uint256,string,string): sets totalSupply, credits msg.sender and sets name/symbol
_transfer(address,address,uint) internal: validates then mutates both balances
transfer(address,uint256) public: forwards msg.sender to _transfer
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public: checks and decrements allowance then calls _transfer
approve(address,uint256) public: writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
approveAndCall(address,uint256,bytes) public: approves then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract
burn(uint256) public: destroys caller tokens and reduces totalSupply
burnFrom(address,uint256) public: destroys tokens of _from using allowance and reduces totalSupply
ChangeableERC20Token constructor: delegates to TokenERC20 constructor
changeName(string) public onlyOwner: rewrites the name state variable
ChangeSymbol(string) public onlyOwner: rewrites the symbol state variable
WarrantToken constructor: mints 1000000000 WAT via ChangeableERC20Token constructor
totalSupply = initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals): unchecked multiplication in the TokenERC20 constructor
balanceOf[_from] -= _value: unchecked balance subtraction in _transfer
balanceOf[_to] += _value: unchecked balance addition in _transfer
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value: unchecked allowance subtraction in transferFrom
spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender,_value,this,_extraData): external call into an arbitrary user supplied contract in approveAndCall
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value: unchecked sender balance subtraction in burn
totalSupply -= _value: unchecked supply decrease in burn
balanceOf[_from] -= _value: unchecked target balance subtraction in burnFrom
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value: unchecked allowance subtraction in burnFrom
totalSupply -= _value: unchecked supply decrease in burnFrom
